With locations in Calais and Ellsworth, Maine, our practice offers a welcoming and professional environment where clients can feel comfortable, relaxed, and cared for throughout every step of their journey. Whether you are interested in improving skin tone and texture, reducing signs of aging, contouring and tightening the body, or exploring therapeutic wellness treatments, our team takes the time to understand your goals and recommend services designed specifically for you. By combining compassionate care with advanced techniques and attention to detail, we help clients achieve refreshed, balanced, and long-lasting results for both the face and body. Why Choose Lotus When choosing a medical spa, experience, credentials, and technology matter. At Lotus Medical & Aesthetics, we provide customized medical-grade treatment plans tailored to your unique skin, body, and wellness goals - never a one-size-fits-all approach. Our highly trained medical professionals stay current with today’s latest aesthetic procedures and advanced technologies through ongoing education and advanced training, helping us deliver safe, effective, and natural-looking results. We are proud to be the only medical-grade spa in Maine offering the advanced Solaria CO2 Laser and one of only two providers in the state featuring Luxora Quantum technology, giving our clients access to some of today’s most innovative aesthetic treatments. From Botox and fillers to laser treatments, body contouring, medical-grade skincare, and wellness services, we provide every treatment in a clean, professional, and private environment with flexible appointments designed to fit your schedule and personalized care focused on your comfort and confidence.
